Key Responsibilities End-to-End Shipment Monitoring: Track and monitor all incoming cargo from the moment it leaves the foreign supplier/port until it arrives safely at our designated facilities. If you are looking for a challenging role in an international logistics environment and want to be part of a team committed to delivering exceptional service to the maritime sector, we would be pleased to hear from you. review_candidates.title: Head of Programme Jordan Country Office
review_candidates.description: Job Description What we are looking for Are you an accomplished humanitarian leader with the strategic vision, fundraising expertise, and leadership influence to shape refugee and humanitarian portfolio in Jordan? This is not simply a programme management position. We are looking for a strategic leader who can identify opportunities, influence key stakeholders, strengthen localization, and secure the funding required to expand impact for refugees and vulnerable communities across Jordan. You will be entrusted with shaping the future direction of NRC's programme portfolio while ensuring excellence in programmatic delivery, accountability, compliance, learning, and organisational growth. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Jordan, We are unable to provide work permits or visa sponsorships for this position. What You Will Do The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is seeking an exceptional Head of Programme to join its senior leadership team in Jordan. This is a pivotal Country Management Group (CMG) role, responsible for leading programme strategy, resource mobilization, grants, MEAL, partnerships, and programme quality across a complex and dynamic humanitarian environment. As a key member of the country leadership team, you will play a central role in delivering NRC Jordan's 2026-2030 Country Strategy while driving sustainable growth through innovative programming, strategic donor engagement, and strong partnerships with national and international stakeholders. Key responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership and oversight to the Programme, Grants, and MEAL functions. Lead the implementation of NRC Jordan's strategic objectives and ensure alignment with country priorities and annual action plans. Drive the development and execution of NRC Jordan's fundraising and resource mobilization strategy. Build and maintain strong relationships with donors, strategic partners, consortium members, government bodies, and humanitarian actors. Identify emerging funding opportunities and position NRC competitively for future growth. Lead grant portfolio management, ensuring high-quality proposal development, compliance, reporting, and donor stewardship. Champion programme quality, evidence-based programming, accountability, and organisational learning. Strengthen partnerships with local and national actors and lead NRC's transition towards more locally led programming approaches. Foster collaboration between technical and operational teams to ensure effective programme delivery. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of technical specialists and programme support functions. What You Will Bring Bachelor’s degree in Development Studies, Social Sciences, International Relations, or a related field. Minimum 6 years of experience in a senior management position within a humanitarian or recovery context, with responsibility for programme and/or project management. Experience in NRC Core Competency programming (ICLA, Shelter, and Education) is an asset. A strong and demonstrated track record in fundraising and donor engagement, including securing significant institutional funding, developing donor relationships, identifying funding opportunities, and shaping winning resource mobilization strategies. Deep knowledge of humanitarian programming, programme quality standards, grants management, and MEAL systems. Experience in integrating evidence-based approaches and programme quality standards throughout the project cycle. Strong understanding of donor priorities, compliance requirements, and the evolving humanitarian and refugee landscape in Jordan and the region Proven experience building and managing partnerships with local and national actors. Experience leading multi-sector, consortium-based, and partnership-driven programmes. Outstanding stakeholder engagement, influencing, and representation skills with s trong strategic, analytical, problem-solving, team-building, interpersonal and conflict-resolution capabilities. The ability to lead, inspire, and develop diverse teams in complex and rapidly changing environments. Fluency in English, both written and verbal and excellent writing skills. Please download the detailed job description to learn more about the position. What We Offer Duty station: Amman, Jordan Fixed term contract: 12 months, renewable based on funding, performance and the need for the position Travel: 30% to Area and Field Offices (NRC Operational Areas) Salary/benefits: Grade 11 on NRC's national grading structure. NRC is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to diversity without distinction to age, gender, religion, ethnicity, nationality, and physical ability. We think outside the box, encourage ideas, and give responsibility to all employees at all levels. You will have many opportunities to be heard and take the initiative. Find out more about the benefits of working for NRC Important information about the application process We invite applications from qualified candidates. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Jordan, We are unable to provide work permits or visa sponsorships for this position. Please ensure you attach copies of your academic and professional certificates. To apply as an internal candidate, log in with your official email address or click on Opportunity Marketplace. When creating your profile, include your full name as given on your passport. Complete all the system-required fields for experience, employment history and education. Submit your application and CV in English, taking care to attach your latest CV. Applications that do not meet the minimum standards in terms of experience or qualifications will generally not be considered. Unsolicited applications not related to this specific job advertisement will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We receive many applicants for each vacant position. Why NRC? The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is an independent humanitarian organisation helping people forced to flee. Our 15,000 staff work in crises across 40 countries, providing life-saving and long-term assistance to millions of people every year. Watch this short video to see NRC in action. We are looking for people who are passionate about helping refugees and people forced to flee. Are you one of those people? If you are, NRC offers you the opportunity to: do demanding and professional work, often in challenging contexts join a work culture that empowers every employee to share ideas and take responsibility be part of a welcoming and supportive community committed to human dignity Learn more about NRC Learn more about NRC Jordan About Us The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is a global humanitarian organisation helping people forced to flee. Join us in assisting millions of people in areas where others cannot, tackling some of the world's most dangerous and difficult crises. Bring your skills and dedication to an organisation recognised for providing high quality aid and for defending the rights of refugees and internally displaced people. At NRC, we give responsibility to employees at all levels and foster professional growth and innovative teams. You can expect a supportive culture and an open dialogue with management. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Together, we save lives and rebuild futures. Safeguarding is central to NRC’s work. We expect all employees to: treat everyone with respect and dignity contribute to building a safe environment for all never engage in any form of exploitation, harassment and specifically sexual exploitation, abuse and sexual harassment (SEAH) always report. NRC has a zero-tolerance approach to inaction against exploitation, abuse and SEAH

For decades, DO & CO has been synonymous with the Formula 1 Paddock Club. Our teams design, build and operate the hospitality environments where the world's most discerning guests experience the sport, from Paddock Club spaces and team suites to partner lounges and bespoke experiences. At DO & CO, every guest is a VIP. We combine culinary artistry, craftsmanship, hospitality innovation and meticulous execution to create moments that are simply unforgettable. Job Description DO & CO is seeking a visionary Head of Partner Activations to lead sponsor, brand and partner activation builds across our Formula 1 hospitality portfolio. This is a senior role for a creative strategist who can turn a partner's ambitions into unforgettable guest experiences. Within Formula 1, DO & CO designs, builds and operates world-class hospitality environments, from Paddock Club spaces and team suites to partner lounges and bespoke experiences. Our Design & Build team creates, produces and delivers these environments around the world. You will be the strategic link between our commercial partners, their brand stakeholders and the Design & Build team. You will combine partnership management, experiential strategy, creative development, project leadership and onsite delivery to ensure every activation serves the partner's objectives, delights our guests and upholds DO & CO's reputation for excellence. You will work with some of the most recognised names in beauty, luxury, food and drink and global sport, including but not limited to: Beauty & wellness: Sephora, Wella Professionals and other beauty and wellness partners Champagne & luxury: Moët & Chandon and LVMH Group brands Food & beverage: Barilla and others Formula 1: Formula 1 Global Partners Fashion & lifestyle: Luxury fashion houses and lifestyle brands Future growth: New strategic commercial partners Key Responsibilities Partner Relationship Management Serve as the primary point of contact for all Global activation partners. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with F1 partner stakeholders at every level. Develop a deep understanding of each partner's brand strategy, marketing objectives and experiential goals. Lead partner planning meetings throughout the Formula 1 season and oversee the project management and build by DO & CO suppliers. Activation Strategy Develop annual and race-specific activation strategies across the DO & CO F1 portfolio. Identify innovative opportunities for guest engagement and new guest experiences. Create compelling activation proposals and recommendations aligned with partner objectives and supplier strengths. Ensure every activation supports business growth and enhances the guest experience. Creative Development Translate partner briefs into distinctive creative concepts and activation strategies. Work within the wider Design & Build team throughout concept development. Ensure activations honour partner brand guidelines and DO & CO standards and vision. Review and approve designs, layouts, finishes and guest journeys. Design & Build Integration Work hand in hand with designers, project managers, producers and installation teams. Write clear creative and technical briefs. Ensure activation requirements are built into suite and hospitality designs from the outset. Guide activation projects from concept through to delivery. Project Leadership Own activation planning timelines and milestones. Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers. Manage activation logistics across the Formula 1 calendar. Ensure activations are delivered on time, on budget and to the highest standard. Onsite Event Delivery Attend selected Formula 1 events around the world. Oversee activation installation and operation. Manage partner expectations throughout race weekends. Act as the senior escalation point for all partner-related matters. Ensure flawless execution and outstanding guest engagement. Commercial Management Develop and manage activation budgets. Track activation performance and return on investment. Identify opportunities to enhance commercial value and future growth. Support partnership renewals through consistently exceptional delivery. Innovation & Growth Stay ahead of emerging trends in luxury hospitality, experiential marketing and Formula 1. Introduce new activation concepts and technologies. Elevate the partner activation offering across DO & CO's hospitality environments. Contribute to business development and new partnership opportunities. Qualifications Experience & Qualifications 8+ years' experience in experiential marketing, sponsorship, hospitality, events, luxury brands or Formula 1. A proven record of managing relationships with premium and luxury brands. Demonstrated success delivering physical activations, brand experiences or hospitality environments. A strong understanding of design, fabrication and event production processes. Experience managing budgets and external suppliers. Confidence presenting to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams. A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Event Management, Hospitality, Design, Business or a related field is preferred; exceptional industry experience is equally valued. Fluent English is essential; additional languages are highly valued. A valid passport and the ability to travel internationally during the Formula 1 season. Core Competencies Strategic partnership management: building partnerships that grow in value season after season. Experiential marketing expertise: knowing what makes a brand experience memorable, shareable and effective. Commercial awareness: connecting every activation to partner ROI and DO & CO's growth. Client leadership: guiding senior partner stakeholders with confidence and credibility. Creative thinking: generating original ideas that surprise guests and delight partners. Design literacy: reading drawings, layouts and finishes, and knowing what works in a hospitality space. Project management: running multiple complex projects across a global calendar. Negotiation skills: securing the best outcomes with partners and suppliers. Financial management: building, controlling and reporting on activation budgets. Stakeholder engagement: aligning partners, creative, production and operations teams. Leadership and team collaboration: inspiring internal teams and external suppliers to deliver their best. Exceptional communication: articulate, persuasive and polished in every setting Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success is measured by the value activations create for partners, guests and DO & CO. Targets will be agreed annually. KPI And How It Is Measured Partner satisfaction: Post-race and end-of-season partner feedback scores Partner retention and renewal: Share of partners renewing and expanding their activations Activation delivery success: Activations delivered to brief, brand standards and quality benchmarks Revenue generated through activations: Activation revenue and incremental commercial value Guest engagement: Footfall, dwell time, participation and guest feedback On-time, on-budget delivery: Projects delivered to agreed timelines and budgets Portfolio growth: New partners, categories and activation formats added Internal stakeholder satisfaction: Feedback from Design & Build, Operations, Sales and Marketing Additional Information We believe that our employees are the driving force behind our success and strive to create a positive and supportive work environment. As a member of our team, you will have access to a range of benefits, including: Competitive salary Location: Global, with travel to selected Formula 1 events Enjoy perks by referring your friends through our Refer a Friend Scheme Save money and time with On-Site Free Meals Expand your skills and knowledge through our in-house training opportunities. A business where you can have a real impact, we’re not afraid of new ideas! Genuine career development opportunities, both nationally and internationally The opportunity to work with and represent one of the most innovative players in the luxury global gourmet entertainment market DO&CO is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status #docolondon

La persona che ricopre il ruolo di Finance Processes & Systems Project Manager entra a far parte dell'area Amministrazione con l'obiettivo di presidiare il corretto funzionamento del sistema gestionale aziendale, basato su Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central e sulle numerose personalizzazioni sviluppate nel tempo per rispondere alle specifiche esigenze dell'organizzazione. The role focuses on executing preventive and corrective maintenance activities, troubleshooting electrical faults, maintaining electrical panels, motors, control circuits, and automation systems, and minimizing equipment downtime. The engineer also supports equipment installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and equipment reliability. Roles & Responsibilities: Execute preventive maintenance plans as scheduled. Perform routine inspections on Electrical systems (panels, wiring, sensors) Report early signs of wear, faults, or inefficiencies. Assist in diagnosing and fixing faults in Electrical systems (basic PLC issues, sensors, wiring) Respond to breakdowns in a timely manner under supervision. Escalate complex issues to senior engineers when needed. Support installation and commissioning of new equipment. Assist in minor modifications to improve machine performance. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives. Follow all safety procedures and guidelines during maintenance work. Apply safe practices in high-risk activities (e.g., lockout/tagout). Report hazards and unsafe conditions immediately. Record maintenance activities, repairs, and downtime accurately. Update checklists and logs for completed tasks. Support data collection for analysis and reporting. Assist in tracking usage of spare parts. Report shortages or critical spare part requirements. Ensure proper handling and storage of components. Work closely with senior engineers and technicians on daily tasks. Actively learn troubleshooting techniques and system operations. Participate in on-the-job training and technical development. Required Education, Knowledge, and Skills: - Basic to intermediate knowledge of: Electrical systems: Electrical panels, motors, control circuits, sensors, wiring, and basic PLC systems. Industrial automation: Basic understanding of PLCs, relays, contactors, and motor control systems. Electrical troubleshooting: Ability to identify electrical faults and perform basic corrective maintenance. Ability to read and interpret basic electrical diagrams, wiring diagrams, and control circuit drawings. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or Mechatronics. Safety Awareness: Understanding of industrial electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO). 1–3 years of experience in electrical maintenance within FMCG, manufacturing, or production environments.
